items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: In fact there was one record I did for Hank Jones where I’m playing alto

ctx.x: And do you hear yourself on T.V. occasionally?

Yes I do. There’s an American Express one that I did that’s played a lot, and Applebee’s, which is a chain, I’m on those. That’s kind of a fun thing. It’s fun to hear myself on the radio once in a while too, on a jazz station. And actually I really honestly, I’m not trying to be falsely modest or anything, but I just don’t listen to my own records. It’s like watching home movies for me. It’s like it’s done, time to move on to the next thing, and I hear every mistake and everything I’d want to fix. And when I do…
